name: Hopeless Shadow
body:
School evocation [darkness, despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, death mage 5, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Duration 10 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell disheartening darkness except it creates a darkness effect as per the deeper darkness spell and imposes the despairing condition.
